Players Committee card image of [[Admiral Piett (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “While piloting Executor, adds 3 to power. Deploys -1 for each of your starship sites on table. Landing Claw may not attach here. Once per game, if piloting Executor, may ▲ Emperor's Orders.” Uploaded unchanged.
